🌐 VPN Generator – to stay connected with loved ones even when everything around is being shut down.

IMPORTANT: here you get an entire server. It's a valuable and limited resource, so there are simple rules:

• Start sharing VPN keys within 24 hours.
• From day 8 after registration, have at least 10 active users.

Or you can get a VIP brigade with higher speed and no waiting.

Press the button below ↓

Great that you decided to become a VPN brigadier and share access to the free internet!

Please send any picture to this chat: we need to make sure you're a real person, not a troll from under the bridge.

On the next step you'll get a VPN brigade. More details in the manual: https://bit.ly/VPNgenManual
Wow, what a picture! Our whole team is looking at it and will answer you soon.

This is where brigades get restored. We can *restore your brigade* if you've lost your config and need to regain control.

Or

We can issue you a *new brigade* if we deleted your old one for violating the terms of use. A new brigade means you'll have to re-distribute configs to your users.

In both cases you _must know the brigadier name and six magic words_. Shall we go?
To restore your config, please type the brigadier name. That is, an adjective and a laureate's surname, for example "Веселый Эйнштейн" or "Потрясающая Кюри".

That doesn't look like a name, please try again. Be careful — you need to enter an adjective and a laureate's surname, for example "Веселый Эйнштейн" or "Потрясающая Кюри".

You can start from scratch. But there's a catch: right now we can't issue a new regular brigade — resources are exhausted.
But you can get a VIP brigade right away 😎. It's yours — no limits, no waiting, no deletions.
Great, now please tell us your 6 magic words.

Open sesame didn't work — something's wrong with the name or the words. Be careful — the name consists of an adjective and a laureate's surname, for example "Веселый Эйнштейн" or "Потрясающая Кюри". And the six words must be in exactly the same order we gave them to you!

If you don't remember the name and/or magic words — maybe it's time to start fresh. But there's a catch: right now we can't issue a new regular brigade — resources are exhausted.
But you can get a VIP brigade right away 😎. It's yours — no limits, no waiting, no deletions.
We recognized you — here's your config!
You're almost a VIP brigadier with maximum protection and speed! Go to the bot to purchase a VIP brigade — it's quick and hassle-free.

Our pleasant conversation has ended.

If you've forgotten your name and 6 important words, even our support team won't be able to help. This is a condition of our security.
